scope: Bounded independent verification of previously unverified subgroup/conditional intervals from existing synthetic CSVs.
intended_use: Research arithmetic audit; no disease, patient, decision or treatment target.
population: 11520 archived fully synthetic Gaussian/Bernoulli rows in three invented sites.
endpoint: Paired Brier(recalibrated)-Brier(fixed) on evaluation rows only.
split: Each of 15 frozen seed/site CSVs:256 calibration,512 evaluation. x1<0 vs x1>=0.
definition: stdlib csv + math.fsum. n/positives exact; Brier means, paired delta mean; SE sqrt(sum((d-mean)^2)/(n-1)/n); group normal critical1.959963984540054. Equal five-seed means and sample SE with t4 critical2.7764451051977987. No pooling; weighted group sums must reproduce full evaluation counts/Brier/delta.
acceptance: All15 raw hashes/header/splits/IDs and11520 rows exact; all30groups+6aggregates numerics within1e-10; group sums consistent; all12 semantic mutants rejected; total verdict fail-closed.
limits: Pure synthetic arithmetic only. Conditional row intervals ignore calibration-set variability; five-seed t4 intervals are rough Monte Carlo summaries. No model/DGP regeneration, calibration refit, clinical or real-population fairness evidence; no causal inference or new medical discovery. Nature primary direct open returned Internal Error and PubMed direct open one-line unavailable content; author-hosted abstract and primary scoping-review abstract were read instead. No full-proof/clinical guideline adjudication; noisy searches cannot establish absence of retraction.
